messages:
tess: CI job `integration/e2e-fleet` turned red on lunchtimes runs — failing fast with `connect: connection refused` to http://test-proxy.internal:8080, looks like a cluster-level 502/connrefused from the mock proxy. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
aj: saw it too, reran job once, still fails. stacktrace shows `dial tcp 10.42.3.12:8080: connect: connection refused` from the test harness.
mike: pinging the infra box — `kubectl get pods -n ci-tests | grep proxy` returns the proxy pod in CrashLoopBackOff.
ci-bot: [automated] Job #7421 failed: integration/e2e-fleet — see https://ci.redwood.example/7421 — failed step `run-e2e`
jen: @tess @aj I'm looking at k8s events now, might be due to the node kube-proxy IPTables refactor we rolled yesterday to fix SNAT. If the proxy's hostPort mapping is wrong it would give conn refused.
tess: can someone grab the last proxy logs? `kubectl logs proxy-5f7d -n ci-tests --previous` — I saw repeated `listen tcp :8080: bind: address already in use` in one of the restarts earlier.
aj: grabbing logs: ```
2026-10-08T11:02:12Z ERROR listen tcp :8080: bind: address already in use
2026-10-08T11:02:13Z INFO starting
2026-10-08T11:02:14Z ERROR listen tcp :8080: bind: address already in use
``` looks like something else grabbed 8080 on that node.
mike: that matches: the node's CI helper daemon accidentally started the old test-proxy binary after the refactor; it binds 8080 and prevents the pod's hostPort. deleting the old daemon fixed it for me on node ci-node-3.
jen: TL;DR likely host-level process conflict, not test harness. I'll coordinate with infra to blacklist the helper on CI nodes and push a short fix to the node-init config.
tess: thanks. quick mitigation: can we change the tests to use serviceClusterIP instead of hostPort for the proxy so it doesn't break when hostPort is noisy? low-effort patch in the test harness might buy us time.
aj: opened PR https://git.redwood.example/r/integration/patches/183 to switch to service DNS for the proxy and added a 5s retry for the initial connect. requesting review from @mike @jen :eyes:
mike: reviewing now, LGTM for a short-term fix. after infra change we can revert to hostPort if needed.
deploy-bot: started node config rollout to CI node pool (ci-node-*) — will stop if more failures reported. :rocket:
tess: ok re-run requested: @ci-bot can you trigger a rerun of #7421 once the PR is merged? also if anyone sees more ephemeral nodes doing the same, @jen please add to the incident note.
ci-bot: acknowledged — rerun will be queued after merge and successful node-config rollout.
jen: adding incident note: "CI proxy hostPort conflict; root cause: legacy helper daemon on nodes binding :8080 after kube-proxy changes. Mitigation: node-init blacklist + test harness switched to cluster service for proxy. Follow up: remove hostPort dependency or reserve ephemeral port range."
tess: thanks everyone, marking the thread resolved once PR merges and one successful green run. :white_check_mark:
